description: A handle to one slice of a dataset, not the data: signed Parquet URLs (valid one hour), schema, row counts, per-column min/max/nulls from the Parquet footers, 5 sample rows and a Polars snippet. Load the files in your own code; never paste them into the conversation. Without code, use summarize. Every argument but dataset defaults to the free preview, which needs no API key.

dataset.description: A dataset id from list_datasets: a metrics dataset such as "flow", or a raw one such as "raw:trades".

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: the end of the free preview month.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: the free preview, 2025-05-01 for metrics, 2025-06-01 for raw.

symbol.description: Symbol id from find_symbols. Default perpetual-BTC-USDT:USDT.

timestamp.description: Metrics only: 'exchange' uses the exchange-reported timestamp (default), 'true' the arrival time at our servers.

name: get_data
title: Get a data handle
